tasks.title: SKILL.md adapted for unattended CI
tasks.description: Step 0 takes PR number and repo from the prompt, uses $JUDGE_BOT_LOGIN, finds previous reviews by login plus <!-- the-judge --> selecting commit_id (round = count + 1, last reviewed commit = latest commit_id). Steps 1, 6 and 7 call scripts as python3 ~/.claude/skills/the-judge/scripts/..., Step 7 with --pr and --repo. The Convergence Contract sentence that forbids a fourth round is replaced by the round 4+ rule (CCR-29). The own-PR paragraph and Troubleshooting replace every human ask with stop and report the reason. All other sections unchanged.
tasks.details: Where: skills/the-judge/SKILL.md. Reuses: aipp SKILL.md. Requirement: CCR-11, CCR-13, CCR-14, CCR-17, CCR-18, CCR-29. Done when: tests/test_skill.sh asserts no gh api user; no ask the user; marker query with commit_id present; round rule text present; no cwd-relative python3 scripts/; post command has --pr and --repo; round 4+ sentence present and never runs a fourth round absent; sections Non-Negotiables, Severity and Verdict, Steps 2-5 byte-equal to aipp; Convergence Contract equal to aipp except the replaced sentence; gate check passes; 26 tests pass. Tests: unit. Gate: quick (bash tests/run.sh). Commit: feat(skill): run the-judge unattended in CI.
tasks.testStrategy: unit (content assertions): tests/test_skill.sh checks no gh api user, no ask the user, marker query with commit_id, round rule, no cwd-relative scripts path, --pr/--repo in post command, round 4+ sentence, and byte-equal unchanged sections; run via bash tests/run.sh

tasks.title: Smoke PR on a test repo
tasks.description: tests/smoke.sh <owner/repo> <pr> plus a run on test repo Ronnasayd/claude-pr-review-smoke that has the caller file and CLAUDE_TOKENS (user creates the secret with real claude setup-token tokens). Open a PR, then push a second commit; tests/smoke.sh asserts the outcome. If /the-judge is not recognised, apply the design's prompt fallback (amending CCR-04, C4 and its assertion), move v1, and push a new commit to the PR; never a re-run, which reuses the first attempt's workflow SHA.
